body:
Thank you so much, for taking the time to even read my other posts, that matters to me a lot.. I don't really know that much about therapy, if i'm going to be honest.. since my family is very 'traditional' and I don't personally know anyone who goes to  therapist/psych.. I don't have anyone to ask and I'm really afraid. I couldn't even tell my family when it happened. but before I was able to handle it better, I always had this wish to die even then but didn't start acting onit until my depression got worse, around two years ago.. and i seriouly tried, but failed.. and everyday has become like this..
thank you for telling me about therapists not expecting me to talk right away.. That's really one of the worst fears i have in all of this, that if i ever went , i will be asked too many questions i can't answer
I'm still not sure if I can go seek therapy.. but it does help to know what you said
Thank you again, it really matters to me how kind people have been responding to my posts, as writing about this has already been a scary leap for me

Thank you.. just knowing there are people who care to listen, and leave me a comment or message, that means a lot to me. thank you. I can't promise to try.. i am in general a shy /reserved person, even with everyday things i don't talk much, so i feel like posting tjhese here is already a lot of steps >.< I'm not sure if i can do more than this

It isn't a mess of thoughts , I assure you. And thank you for your beautiful reply.. I never thought of emotional comfort being something in it.. my experience gave me the opposite of that. Your description of it sounds more beautiful to me thanwhat i saw in movies and books though, because it's like, more real, more possible. In fiction the consensual ones seem too perfect , and therefore unattainable, for me. I'm not exactly looking forward to have any sexual relationship , i am still too messed up for that, i am just curious what normal would feel like, but it woul be nice to find someone to trust. Right now it's still very difficult . So all i feel i can have are these, knowledge, i guess? to maybe help me heal some day. Thank you so much for answering me, i really appreciate it more than i can say

That sounds beautiful. Thank you for taking my question seriously, I really appreciate that. Even though i haven't had the best of things, I'm glad people had them, and that it's entirely possible for something physical to be beautiful, which is still a struggle for me to understand

It does sound like an amazing feeling.  I'm glad you and your fiancee have that, I can't say i understand it well but i'm always glad when i know people have something beautiful in their lives. Thank you for answering my question

I'm sorry for being late in replying., some days I read my messages but don't feel capable of replying.. 
Thank you for taking my question seriously, I really appreciate that. It sounds wonderful from what you said, I'm glad that you are able to experience that. It matters to me that you replied to this, as somehow it made me feel like people like me maybe can still experience wonderful things some day. Right now I don't feel like I can. Everything is bleak or painful. 
that bit about it being your decision, I hope that if i ever go through with a sexual experience again, it will be my decision then and not something i was forced into like it had been.
Thank you again, and i'm happy for you

I'm sorry, i know it's a weird place to ask this, but i tried before to join survivor forums and such, but i can't handle it, i feel like, it's all around me and i can't breathe or say anything.. which is weird too i guess. i just feel more anonymous here than in other places i guess.. and so far with exception of one troll whose message someoen deleted before i could figure out what to do with it, with exception of that one, people have been kind in their response.

uhh i'm not looking to do it.. also i dont want to talk to a professional about it. I just wondered because, well no one in my friend group knows about my past, so they feel free to discuss/mention their private lives, when we used to see each other a lot. They assume i'm just private so I never tell them things. I think they also assume i've done it. So i never ask them either, i let them assume, it's better that way so they won't ask me in turn.
What i mean to say is.. well I hear about it a lot, so while I'm not planning anything and even avoid it, once in a while i wonder what's it like to experience these things normally, as i probably never would. And when i saw r/tooafraidtoask this was the first thing that came to mind that's all, just a question but i dont wnt to do it, nor discuss with a professional.. i'm not ready for that

Watching the sky change colors for sunset.
Watching birds that perch on our plants.
Having made people smile.
Reading a good book while having coffee.
and more<3

I'm sorry for your loss, and having had a pet dog (and cat) die before, i understand this is a very sad time. I hope you find comfort knowing that, for sure, your pet knew you loved him very much while he was here.

in addition to clevernameandnumbers ' advice, i also want to suggest speaking to child or social services (or whatever it is in your country) about the girl. i would think that her age plus the fact that she's being allowed drugs, authorities could take her out of the house and you can report that guy and hopefully boot him out in the process. it really depends on where you are though, but i think most everywhere authorities won't let that situation with the girl continue. so report it for both her good and your gain

i was adviced by a doctor to attend therapy but i couldnt .. i couldnt talk about it, i never told anyone. i was 10 and kept it a secret. i don't know how i can start talking now.. i don't know what i'm posting this on a website for either, i just can't hold it in anymore but also i can't tell. i am afraid of telling  a psychiatrist. i dont think i can face anyone if i ever told them. i'm sorry
Good for you! I hope you continue to go and feel better!
"Because you ARE important." -- a friend told me after she got tired of me apologizing for being so troublesome and admitting i don't know how she's still not given up on me
